decode-uri-component.reason: MinIO 8.0.7 only calls query-string stringify; its production source does not call query-string parse, so the vulnerable decoder is not invoked. MinIO PR #1494 is not build-clean.

query-string.reason: This is the propagated decode-uri-component finding. Hypha reaches query-string only through MinIO's stringify calls.

stream-json.reason: MinIO imports the JSONL parser; the advisory affects pick, ignore, filter, and replace path filters and explicitly excludes streamers. MinIO PR #1497 breaks the current import path.

minio.reason: Aggregate npm audit finding propagated from the two reviewed, unreachable transitive paths documented above.
